name: Publishing Desk
permissionsNotice: Bot Cabinet generates plans and packages. Hermes Desktop settings and connected-service permissions are applied by you. Passports are checklists, not locks.

members.name: Scout
members.responsibility: Find timely subjects and source material inside the approved brief.
requestedCapabilities: Optional read-only access to an approved source list
approvalActions: A person selects the topics to pursue
A person verifies important claims against the linked sources before publication
members.firstTest: Review five approved sources and return three ideas with working links.

members.name: Researcher
members.responsibility: Check claims, organize evidence, and mark gaps or conflicting sources.
requestedCapabilities: Read-only document access when I provide files
approvalActions: A person makes legal, medical, financial, and policy decisions
members.firstTest: Answer one narrow question using at least three approved sources and identify any unresolved conflict.

members.name: Story
members.responsibility: Shape the central message for the intended audience.
requestedCapabilities: Read-only access to approved source documents
Optional web research for checking supplied facts
approvalActions: Ask before changing protected language or substantive meaning
A person decides what the organization stands for and approves every public claim and final draft
members.firstTest: Use three approved source documents to create a one-page narrative brief and mark every unsupported claim.

members.name: Writer
members.responsibility: Create the main draft and approved channel versions.
requestedCapabilities: Optional web access for checking supplied links
approvalActions: A person approves factual claims and final wording
members.firstTest: Draft a 500-word article from one approved outline and three supplied sources.

members.name: Editor
members.responsibility: Improve clarity, check claims, and return approval questions.
requestedCapabilities: Optional web access for checking supplied links
members.firstTest: Edit a two-page memo and explain the five most important changes.

handoffOrder.action: Select the topic and approve sources.
Build the evidence brief and mark gaps.
Create the main piece and channel versions.
Check the package and decide whether to publish.

approvalActions: Change a public claim, price, or promise
